subtopic: Auction Rate Securities Buybacks and Redemptions
source_evidence: These settlements included agreements to buy back ARS from certain investors.  In addition, many issuers of ARS have redeemed their ARS and converted to other types of securities.
question: Misconception: After the ARS market collapsed, every investor was automatically entitled to have their securities bought back.
answer: The source does not say that all investors were entitled to a buyback. It says settlements included buyback agreements for certain investors. It also notes that many issuers redeemed their ARS and converted them to other types of securities.
